mapper.select: SELECT t.*, s.name AS store_name FROM t_dining_table t LEFT JOIN t_store s ON s.id = t.store_id WHERE t.store_id = #{storeId} ORDER BY t.table_number
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_dining_table (store_id, table_number, qr_token, seats, status) VALUES (#{storeId}, #{tableNumber}, #{qrToken}, #{seats}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_dining_table SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
